source: Generated from the validated RPCS3 build-history master database (rpcs3.net builds history captured 2026-09-19, 7536 rows) and the complete RPCS3/rpcs3-binaries-win release listing refreshed 2026-09-19. OFFICIAL_GITHUB_DIRECT rows are exact official Windows binaries and the only downloadable rows. OFFICIAL_SITE_ARCHIVE_POINTER rows are historical Internet Archive evidence (metadata/identity verified, never hash verified) and are reference data only: no Archive download is offered. Ambiguous or unresolved history rows are not shipped and resolve to nothing. Regenerate with R3Test --gen-build-catalog; do not edit by hand.
